meta.what: Expected kcal band for one default portion of each dish: recipe + declared baseline cooking fat, at the median kitchen. Enforced by test/dish-bands.test.ts.
meta.why: A dish enters the table only with a number someone is willing to write down. MASTER: the dish table is not delegable to a model.
meta.basis: Bands are +/-20% around the values verified by hand on 13 Jul 2026 (docs/nutrition-verification.md), recomputed after the serving_g portion-basis fix on 28 Jul 2026. +/-20% is Slate spec/06 stated accuracy target.
meta.status: REGRESSION PINS, not independent review. They catch a recipe edit that moves a dish materially. Replacing a pin with a band from a published source is the review step - note the source in this file when you do.
